name: martix-power-platform

publisher.name: MartiXDev
publisher.distributionModel: standalone skill with direct Copilot marketplace registration

summary: Standalone-first guidance for Power Platform environments, Power Automate cloud flows, and custom connector engineering.
abstract: This package routes Power Platform work to focused guidance for environments and flow types, OpenAPI 2.0 connector definitions, authentication, x-ms extensions, triggers, policies, custom code, testing, ALM, versioning, sharing, and certification.

status.scaffoldNote: Initial preview package derived from the 2026-08-13 Microsoft Learn research snapshot; volatile product values require revalidation.

rulePrefixes.foundation-flow-environments: Product surface, cloud-flow type, environment, runtime graph, permissions, licensing, DLP, gateway, and VNet boundaries
rulePrefixes.connector-authoring: REST API wrapper, blank designer, OpenAPI 2.0, Postman format checks, paconn files, operation design, and API prerequisites
rulePrefixes.authentication-connections: Anonymous, Basic, API key, OAuth, Entra ID, managed identity, multi-auth, connection parameters, redirects, and secret boundaries
rulePrefixes.openapi-extensions: Swagger schemas, operation metadata, x-ms visibility, dynamic values/schema, test connection, chunking, and trigger annotations
rulePrefixes.triggers-runtime: Power Automate and Logic Apps polling/webhook triggers, state, registration, callback, batching, and duplicate events
rulePrefixes.policies-custom-code: Policy templates, runtime expressions, request/response shaping, ScriptBase custom code, limits, and network constraints
rulePrefixes.testing-troubleshooting-limits: Designer tests, validation, Solution Checker, run history, retries, pagination, throttling, limits, and failure diagnosis
rulePrefixes.solutions-alm-versioning: Solutions, connection references, environment variables, Dataverse APIs, and operational versioning
rulePrefixes.sharing-certification: Private sharing, certification submission, publisher evidence, public distribution, and product boundaries

notes: Use the standalone package as the source of truth for local installs and direct folder validation.

secondarySurface.strategy: Register the canonical standalone package directly from skills after coordinator review.

discovery.sameNameConflictRisk: A standalone project or personal install can shadow a later marketplace-delivered copy with the same skill name.
discovery.recommendedValidationApproach: Use a clean environment or remove any standalone install before marketplace validation.
